description:
Your brand-new house is lying to you.

The "wood" is plastic. The "luxury" cabinets are cardboard. 
The $40K upgrade package cost the builder $4K. And the framing? 
It meets code — barely.

We expose the materials, markups, and engineering shortcuts that 
make modern homes look incredible and fall apart in 10 years.

🔔 Subscribe before you sign anything:
https://www.youtube.com/@TheNewHomeIllusion?sub_confirmation=1

What we cover:
→ Builder upgrade scams exposed
→ Cheap materials hiding behind premium prices  
→ Structural shortcuts inspectors won't flag
→ Red flags every new home buyer misses

New homes have never looked this good. Or been this bad.
